participation.context: Kept the rumour apart from what she saw, and said the Paul's errand was not this week.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Set the rule, west of the Stocks, lodger included, and put the loaf on the table.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Brought the buckets half full, and separated the churchyard from the talk on the way.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: west of the Stocks, this month
relations.quote: Nobody in this house goes west of the Stocks again this month. The lodger included.

story.body: You heard Alse's two tellings and did not join them. You gave up Paul's. Mistress Ansell shut the house off from anything west of the Stocks for the rest of the month.
